entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thanks for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return. My order number is VF55192-B.
Certainly, I can help you with that. Let me just pull up that order. One moment... Okay, I see it here. It looks like the item is the Aero-Dynamic Helmet?
That's the one. The helmet. The color just isn't what I expected. Can I return it or not?
I can definitely look into that for you. Is there a technical fault, or is it a preference?
It's a preference. The box is unopened, still sealed. I just need a yes or no on the return so I can get on with my day.
Understood. Let me check the purchase date... I see it was delivered 81 days ago. Yes, you are absolutely within the return window.
Good. So you're sending the label?

Yes. Our standard return policy is 90 days, so you have plenty of time. We want to make sure you're completely satisfied, especially with something as important as safety gear. I have just processed the return for you and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Is there anything else I can assist with?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a great day.
